name: URW Universal Title
epitaph: Announced on the promotion's opening broadcast as its top championship, to be decided the following week in a 25-man battle royale not held in the held record.

name: URW International Title
epitaph: Announced on the promotion's opening broadcast as its secondary championship, to be decided in a four-way ladder match not held in the held record.

name: URW United States Title
epitaph: Announced on the promotion's opening broadcast as its third singles championship; no tournament or match toward it survives in the held record.

name: URW Television Title
epitaph: Announced on the promotion's opening broadcast, with an eight-man tournament toward it beginning the following week, not held in the held record.

name: URW Suicide Title
epitaph: Announced on the promotion's opening broadcast as a hardcore-styled championship for its most extreme competitors; no tournament or match toward it survives in the held record.

name: URW World Tag-Team Titles
epitaph: Announced on the promotion's opening broadcast; no tournament or match toward them survives in the held record.
